verdict.rationale: Neon documents connecting MCP clients to its hosted MCP Server so users can "interact with your Lakebase Postgres databases in natural language." The server exposes a 113-tool surface covering SQL, schema migrations, branches, snapshots, compute, auth, functions and storage, and probes confirm it is live, OAuth-gated and serves scoped tool lists. Natural-language helpers are also built in: the SQL Editor AI features, `neon ask`, and custom Copilot agents for migrations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end natural-language operation (probes only confirm the server is reachable and lists tools), and the first-party natural-language surfaces (`neon ask`, SQL Editor AI) are limited to docs Q&A and SQL assistance rather than full platform control.
